Kevin Garnett is the realest motherfucker to listen to in sports. Absolute unbridled authenticity, passion, and raw emotion. 

Never had to replicate, because was always the original. 

Not an ounce of cuck energy. Just one of the best and realest to ever do it.

Whenever he talks, you listen. You always know when he’s being respectful and when he’s being disrespectful. He doesn’t mask anything. He’ll even let you know when he’s just hating, doesn’t try to justify or rationalize it. Dude is as honest as there is. Even when he’s being “disrespectful” you almost respect it. Because you know it’s real.

I would rather listen to this man talk basketball than any of these hot take artists on these garbage talk shows making tens of millions. Not even close.

This is also one of my favorite pictures, and why I respect LeBron and the ‘08 Celtics so much. That team admitted to basically just trying to hack and destroy LeBron at any chance. Here LeBron was fouled/tackled in transition, and LeBron’s mom stood up to yell at Pierce. Pierce and KG were respectful to mom and gracefully took the earful, while LeBron defended Pierce and KG as just playing physical basketball. 

We ended up getting a legendary series, with LeBron posterizing KG in game 6, and both he and Pierce dropping 40+ in a Game 7 duel.

College hoops is like corporate America. You’ll never reach your full potential there. It’s a system that self sustains by reducing prospects to a mold. Easier to scout, train, coach, replace. Year after year. A cesspool of mediocrity, risk aversion, and conformity. You’ll never be great or memorable. They’ll cut your nuts off and waste your talent and millions of others year after year. 

Kyrie will be Kyrie on the playgrounds growing up. He will be Irving in college. Then he will be Kyrie again in the pros.

Steph is Steph as a kid. He’s Stephen in college. Then Steph again in the pros. 

Luka, LeBron, Trae… 

The kids on the playgrounds get it right. The NBA gets it right. The NBA breeds creativity. Encourages it. It also has the best minds and leadership that know how to cultivate and optimize talent and rosters. 

It’s high testosterone, high risk, high creativity hoops. Gives you the best show on Earth. The best minds and talent win.

Now, not a perfect analogy, but you get the gist. Shump gets it. The pro players get it. The kids get it. 

USA hoops gets it right. Lamelo was overseas at 5’10”, 13 years old cooking grown men with a smile on his face.
